io.name: clk
io.description: Clock signal; all D flip-flops trigger on the positive edge.

io.name: reset
io.description: Active high synchronous reset; when high at a positive clock edge, all outputs are set to zero.

io.name: d
io.description: Data input bus; each bit is captured into the corresponding flip-flop on the positive clock edge when reset is low.

io.name: q
io.description: Registered output bus; reflects the value of d captured at the most recent positive clock edge, or zero after a synchronous reset.

functional_summary.overview: Eight D flip-flops sharing a positive-edge clock and an active high synchronous reset. On each positive clock edge, if reset is high, q is set to 0; otherwise q captures the current value of d.
rules: All eight flip-flops are triggered by the positive edge of clk.
reset is active high and synchronous: it takes effect only at a positive clk edge.
When reset is high at a positive clk edge, q is set to 8'b00000000.
When reset is low at a positive clk edge, q is updated to the value of d present at that edge.
q holds its value between positive clock edges.
Output q reflects the captured value one cycle after the sampling edge (latency_cycles = 1).
